fact: The procurement plan of the World Bank-financed Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery Project (IDA grant D8380), whose executing agency is the Ministry of Finance, lists the contract "Hiring a service provider for the provision of Internet Services for the Local Councils to facilitate the Implementation of PFM Smart" (SL-MOF-497480-NC-RFQ, estimated USD 75,000, request for quotations on the national market) as completed in the plan revised on 30 June 2026, with dates of 12 August 2025 and 18 November 2025 against its signing and completion columns; the plan does not name the provider, the technology or the number of councils.
title: Procurement Plan: Sierra Leone: Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery (P172492)
